Tile Flooring Installation in Phoenix, AZ

Tile floors that sit flat, look straight, and hold up for decades. I install ceramic, porcelain, and stone tile floors across the Phoenix area, with the subfloor prep that keeps tiles from cracking later.

What is included

  • Ceramic, porcelain, and stone tile floors
  • Kitchens, bathrooms, entryways, and whole-home tile
  • Subfloor prep and leveling
  • Straight grout lines, sealed where it counts
  • Transitions finished clean where tile meets other floors
